name: University of Vienna / Vienna School of Mathematics
header:
University of Vienna / Vienna School of
Mathematics
Austria · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate and separately advertised VSM employment
European research-fit addition. VSM is joint with TU Wien; the ordinary MSc described here is University of Vienna.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc application requires an already completed bachelor; predicted graduation is insufficient.
• Winter 2027-28 dates remain unpublished.
• No guaranteed MSc living stipend.
• VSM is a doctoral network with separate project/job applications; its posts are not a direct-bachelor US-style
PhD round.
• Krattenthaler is retired; Hauser and Schwermer are also retired/emeritus in the current roster.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor is assessed individually, with no advance equivalence ruling. Subject
gaps may require up to30 ECTS of supplementary exams within two semesters; larger gaps preclude
admission. Crucially, the degree must already be fully completed when applying to this programme without
selection procedure: future-completion letters and provisional transcripts are not accepted. Doctorate normally
requires a relevant master or qualification at the same level, plus a supervisor; no assured direct route from
the UChicago bachelor was established. [s1] [s4] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Wait until the bachelor is completed, obtain final records or an official completion confirmation, prepare English
evidence, create a u:account and apply through u:space. US-issued educational documents need no diplomatic
legalisation; English records need no translation. Later doctorate: obtain supervision confirmation and project
agreement in principle before academic application; apply separately to funded jobs. [s2] [s4] [s6] [s9] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require a supervisor; the curriculum recommends contacting an adviser in the first
semester for course planning. Later doctoral admission does require a qualified supervisor’s written
confirmation. Current research-fit faculty below do not imply an open 2027 position. [s7] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create/activate u:account, register personal data and ID in u:space, upload complete records, review and click
Submit application; only submitted status initiates review. Admission letter arrives by email and in Personal
Matters/My Documents. Job5204 uses the university job portal, with referee emails sent separately. [s2] [s12]
[s13]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Summer 2027 MSc dates and current November 2026-January 2027 VSM job deadlines are explicit. Winter
2027-28 MSc dates and future funded calls are not published in the sources checked. New entrants follow the
2025 MSc curriculum corrected inJanuary 2026. [s3] [s7] [s11]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc requires B2 English, not German. Accepted degree evidence: completed full-time programme of at least
two years, entirely English-taught, at an institution in the US or another listed country. Tests valid no more
than three years: published TOEFL iBT94 or IELTS Academic6.5; the page still uses the legacy TOEFL scale.
Doctoral guidance generally expects C1 English/German depending on the project. [s1] [s5] [s9] [s30]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed English-taught UChicago bachelor satisfies the published educational-evidence route, with
diploma/completion evidence and transcript. It also meets the same degree-based C1 evidence rule where
applicable. F-1 status alone is irrelevant to the exemption. [s4] [s5]

general doctoral academic procedure. Individual funded-job conditions remain separate. [s2] [s7] [s9]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
No CV appears in the ordinary MSc required list/curriculum. Doctoral academic admission: compact CV,
maximum 3 pages, covering education, experience, languages/skills and academic achievements. Mellit job
also requires an academic CV; its separate notice gives no CV page limit. [s2] [s7] [s9] [s13]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed MSc annual stipend found. Current Mellit job quotes EUR3776.10/month gross at full time,
paid14 times/year; the advertised appointment is30 hours/week. If prorated to75% of a40-hour week,
arithmetic is EUR2832.075/month and EUR39649.05/year gross, subject to payroll rounding/contract
confirmation. This is the 2026 advertisement, not a guaranteed Fall 2027 rate or offer. [s11] [s12] [s15]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc: no support guarantee. Mellit employment is four years from agreed start, initially contracted for 1.5 years
and extended to four unless the employer issues a nonextension declaration in the first12 months. Other VSM
positions may have different terms. [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
VSM advertises international recruitment; no citizenship exclusion appears in the examined post. Master
equivalence and employment/residence permissions still matter. Austrian statutory student aid/merit schemes
have citizenship or equal-status rules; US F-1 status does not establish eligibility. [s11] [s12] [s16]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Funded doctoral employment includes research, teaching and administration, active VSM participation and a
dissertation agreement within12-18 months. Academic admission alone does not provide employment. For an
MSc, budget tuition and living expenses without assuming an assistantship. [s12] [s30]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Yes for doctoral employment: apply to the relevant job/project and separately obtain university doctoral
admission. Multiple VSM positions require separate applications. No automatic incoming-MSc funding
application was identified. [s9] [s11] [s15]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
University guidance links grants.at, Austrian student-aid and student-union databases. Awards have separate
nationality/residency/performance conditions and cannot be treated as a universal package. No additional
incoming award amount or 2027 deadline was verified for this applicant. [s15] [s16]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No mathematics application charge was established in the public checklist; do not infer one from tuition.
Current ordinary non-EU tuition is EUR726.72 plus EUR26.20 student-union contribution per semester,
totalEUR752.92;2027 changes remain possible. These are enrollment/study charges, not application fees. [s2]
[s14]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Tuition remission/equal-status categories depend on citizenship and Austrian legal circumstances; ordinary US
F-1 status is not such an exemption. China is not on the listed developing-country automatic-remission list. An
application-fee waiver process was not identified. [s14]

University of Vienna / Vienna School of
Mathematics
Austria · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate and separately advertised VSM employment
European research-fit addition. VSM is joint with TU Wien; the ordinary MSc described here is University of Vienna.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc application requires an already completed bachelor; predicted graduation is insufficient.
• Winter 2027-28 dates remain unpublished.
• No guaranteed MSc living stipend.
• VSM is a doctoral network with separate project/job applications; its posts are not a direct-bachelor US-style
PhD round.
• Krattenthaler is retired; Hauser and Schwermer are also retired/emeritus in the current roster.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor is assessed individually, with no advance equivalence ruling. Subject
gaps may require up to30 ECTS of supplementary exams within two semesters; larger gaps preclude
admission. Crucially, the degree must already be fully completed when applying to this programme without
selection procedure: future-completion letters and provisional transcripts are not accepted. Doctorate normally
requires a relevant master or qualification at the same level, plus a supervisor; no assured direct route from
the UChicago bachelor was established. [s1] [s4] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Wait until the bachelor is completed, obtain final records or an official completion confirmation, prepare English
evidence, create a u:account and apply through u:space. US-issued educational documents need no diplomatic
legalisation; English records need no translation. Later doctorate: obtain supervision confirmation and project
agreement in principle before academic application; apply separately to funded jobs. [s2] [s4] [s6] [s9] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require a supervisor; the curriculum recommends contacting an adviser in the first
semester for course planning. Later doctoral admission does require a qualified supervisor’s written
confirmation. Current research-fit faculty below do not imply an open 2027 position. [s7] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create/activate u:account, register personal data and ID in u:space, upload complete records, review and click
Submit application; only submitted status initiates review. Admission letter arrives by email and in Personal
Matters/My Documents. Job5204 uses the university job portal, with referee emails sent separately. [s2] [s12]
[s13]

Summer 2027 MSc dates and current November 2026-January 2027 VSM job deadlines are explicit. Winter
2027-28 MSc dates and future funded calls are not published in the sources checked. New entrants follow the
2025 MSc curriculum corrected inJanuary 2026. [s3] [s7] [s11]
